description: This Java class 'InteropTransferResponseData' extends 'InteropResponseData' and encapsulates response data for a transfer operation in an interoperation system. It includes fields like transferCode and completedTimestamp, along with various static builder methods to instantiate objects with different sets of data.

classes.name: InteropTransferResponseData
classes.description: A final class representing the response data for an interoperation transfer, including transfer code and timestamp details, extending the base 'InteropResponseData' class.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Multiple overloaded static factory methods to instantiate 'InteropTransferResponseData' with different combinations of parameters.

methods.name: getTransferCode
methods.description: Returns the transfer code associated with the transfer response.

methods.name: getCompletedTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the completed timestamp as a String.

methods.name: getCompletedTimestampDate
methods.description: Parses and returns the completed timestamp as a LocalDateTime object. Throws ParseException if parsing fails.
